description: Intermediate per-action voice-group list selected by a CharacterVoiceGroupSet row; its entries point to VoiceGroupDataTable rows that hold the actual voice lottery candidates.

Id.technical: FName primary key. CharacterVoiceGroupSetDataTable's action-specific FName fields (for example NormalAttack1, CursedEnergyAttack1_2, ExtraAttack1) are passed to Action_FindCharacterVoiceGroupRow over DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x530); the first typed table containing this Id wins. All observed callers pass bCheckNone=true, so None selections return no row. Export spells it ID.

Id_VoiceGroup.simple: Ordered list of VoiceGroupDataTable IDs; one is chosen by the current action step/index.
Id_VoiceGroup.technical: TArray<FName>. The action object's GetVoiceGroupRow returns this row; PlayVoice then picks Id_VoiceGroup[GroupIndex] and resolves it through ActionController_FindVoiceGroupRow in DTM.VoiceGroupDataTables (+0x750). For generic action voice (Kind 2), GroupIndex is the voice request's Index, or GetAttackVoiceIndex() when Index==0; other Kind cases use Index or Index-1. There is no bounds check on the array; bCheckNone is true for most Kinds and false for Kind 2, but the finder also rejects None internally. Exported rows contain many trailing None placeholders.

notes: Loaded as a 'DataTable' primary asset named CharacterVoiceGroupDataTable into DTM.CharacterVoiceGroupDataTables (+0x530); the shared finder walks tables in order and checks the row struct type before FindRow.

This table is the middle join of a three-level voice chain: CharacterSoundDataTable.Id_CharacterVoiceGroupSet -> CharacterVoiceGroupSetDataTable action field -> this table's Id_VoiceGroup -> VoiceGroupDataTable.Id_Voice -> VoiceDataTable cues.

Character-specific controller overrides (CP_020, CP_050, CP_070, CP_110, CP_120, CP_200, CP_230, CN_140, CN_230) choose different fields of the set row and therefore different rows here; normal and cursed-energy attack classes do the same based on attack substep and cursed-energy level.
The companion export contains 2,460 rows; retail completeness and Blueprint-only references are not asserted. Source is reconstructed from the retail binary, with retail RVAs recorded inline.

usages.detail: Typed first-row finder for CharacterVoiceGroupDataTable rows.
Normal-attack action classes select a row by set field and substep.
Cursed-energy attacks select level 1/2/3 rows from the set.
Generic Kind-1 path resolves the default-action row.
Kind-2 path asks the active action object for this row.
Resolves the selected Id_VoiceGroup entry to a VoiceGroup row.
Character-specific extra-attack overrides resolve rows from the set.
